spec.text: Image 1 is the man's model sheet, image 2 the woman's model sheet, image 3 a real photo of a traditional red-brick sanheyuan courtyard house in Yunlin, Taiwan, image 4 the approved art style. Recreate the courtyard house from image 3 (red brick, tiled roof, low walls) on a sunny morning in the warm matte clay and gouache storybook style of image 4, green rice fields beyond. The SAME couple in their casual outfits stand at the main doorway with two smiling elderly grandparents in the same clay style, posing together for a family photo, full bodies. Cinematic 16:9. No readable text, no photorealism.
